'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male Septimontian officer who is accompanied by a [[Ta-da]]. He is involved in the Trophy: ''[[DIY Instructions]]''. 
__NOTOC__
Afterwards, he can be found down the stars from [[Solis Tavern]] at night.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;'''Aurus''' What's gotten into this Ta-da...?

:'''Aurus''' What's gotten into this Ta-da...?
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong?
:'''Aurus''' This Ta-da here only goes "ta-da" every time it hears someone sigh... It's driving me mad!
:'''Aurus''' It's supposed to be cheering every time a Gladiator lands a spectacular blow... I have no idea what to do now...
:{{DIcon}} Make the most out of its talents.
:{{DIcon}} Have it "ta-da" in an environment where it feels comfortable.
:'''Aurus''' ...! I see! You're a genius!
:'''Aurus''' I've got an idea. I'll have it encourage Gladiators that are beaten down and help cheer them up.
:'''Aurus''' It'll become the best Ta-da cheerleader ever!
----
;(Night)
;:'''Excited Child''' It's so cute!

:'''Excited Child''': Can you make this Ta-da do more "ta-da", Mr. Aurus?
:'''Aurus''': More "ta-da"? I can maybe try... Like this?
:'''Excited Child''': Woah! That's amazing!
{{Dialogue End}}
